module_profiles.label: City Core
module_profiles.description: Install the beta-ready city-core profile: records, clerk, municipal code, and public notices on CivicCore.

module_profiles.disabled_reason: queued - depends on Tier 2 module work after city-core ships

module_profiles.label: Full Suite

installer_steps: Explain unsigned beta status and Windows SmartScreen.
Choose install and local data locations.
Install CivicCore and selected city-core modules.
Create city profile and first admin user.
Download and verify Gemma 4 12B quantization-aware weights.
Verify local health, backup, repair, and uninstall entry points.

steps.label: Welcome and unsigned beta notice
steps.summary: CivicSuite is beta software from an unsigned open-source build.
steps.detail: The installer explains that this build is not code-signed yet and should be installed only from the official CivicSuite release source after checksum verification.
steps.next_action: Review the unsigned beta notice before continuing.

steps.label: Windows SmartScreen explanation
steps.summary: Windows may show an Unknown Publisher warning for this beta.
steps.detail: The installer explains why the warning appears and how More info and Run anyway apply to this verified unsigned beta.
steps.next_action: Confirm the warning text matches the CivicSuite guidance.

steps.label: Install and local data locations
steps.summary: Choose where the app and city data live on this machine.
steps.detail: The default locations stay under the current Windows user profile and can be changed before local services are installed.
steps.next_action: Choose install, data, and backup folders.

steps.label: Module selection
steps.summary: City Core is selected by default and CivicCore is locked on.
steps.detail: Custom selection is part of the architecture, but only modules with passing package and proof contracts can be installed from the clerk path.
steps.next_action: Review the City Core module set.

steps.label: City profile
steps.summary: Enter the city name, state, time zone, records contact, and clerk contact.
steps.detail: The city profile personalizes notices, records responses, code guidance, and audit context.

steps.label: First admin user
steps.summary: Create the first local administrator before staff work begins.
steps.detail: The first admin owns setup, model download, users, roles, backup settings, and recovery contact information.
steps.next_action: Create the first admin user, then sign in with that local passcode before continuing setup.

steps.label: Backup default
steps.summary: Choose the default local backup folder.
steps.detail: Backup is configured before city work begins so records, packets, notices, code imports, and audit entries have a recovery path.

steps.label: Local AI model download
steps.summary: Download Gemma 4 12B quantization-aware weights for local AI.
steps.detail: A signed-in CivicSuite local administrator downloads the pinned model with resumable download, checksum verification, and local-only default behavior.
steps.next_action: Sign in as the local administrator, then download and verify the pinned local model weights.

steps.label: Health verification
steps.summary: Verify local services, storage, backup, and the local model before staff work.
steps.detail: The health step checks the desktop shell, local data store, workflow services, task queue, local AI model, and document storage.

steps.label: Finish and lifecycle entry points
steps.summary: Open CivicSuite and keep repair, backup, and uninstall reachable.
steps.detail: The finish screen links the app, System Health, repair, backup, and uninstall so the same product surface owns the lifecycle.
steps.next_action: Open CivicSuite after all setup checks pass.

checks.next_action: Keep this pinned model contract with the Windows Local 1.0 installer.

checks.next_action: Download the pinned GGUF file during first-run setup.

checks.label: Checksum verification
checks.message: Checksum verification has been recorded for the pinned file.
checks.next_action: Verify the local file against the pinned SHA-256 before enabling AI workflows.

checks.next_action: Start the bundled Ollama runtime after the portable runtime is installed.

checks.label: Gemma model loaded in Ollama
checks.message: civicsuite-gemma4-12b-qat:q4_0 is available to the local Ollama runtime.
checks.next_action: Load the verified Gemma model into the local Ollama runtime before staff workflows use AI.

checks.label: CivicCore model registry
checks.message: CivicCore has a local registry entry for this verified model.
checks.next_action: Register the verified model with CivicCore before staff workflows use it.

model.next_action: Use first-run setup to download, resume, and verify the pinned local model.
